items.en: Russia has lost about 13 military aircraft since late September, Defence Blog tallies: seven Su-34s destroyed on the ground by Ukrainian strikes, a Tu-95MS and two Su-30SMs in crashes, and a Su-57 burned out at Akhtubinsk

items.sEn: Defence Blog puts Russia's military aviation losses at about a dozen aircraft in roughly five weeks. It bases the count on the Ukrainian open-source project Oko Gora, which counted 11 Russian fighter aircraft and one helicopter lost in October, plus two Su-34s partially damaged.
